title: [finding] service-analytics' filter normalizer reads an implicit-equality ARRAY as `IN`, while ruling 乙 refuses the same shape at the shared face "for every driver at once"
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**: `packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/filter-normalizer.ts`. Finding class **(b)**, measured against ruling 乙 (`5793368540`).

Found by the `os-dev` round on #19757 (PR #19882, ruling 乙 `5793368540`: an array in the equality slot is refused at the shared comparand-shape face) and filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`, seat post #6017). Devs do not open issues. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The two answers

- **The shared face**, after PR #19882: `{ stage: ['won', 'lost'] }` (implicit equality with an array) is refused with INVALID_FILTER / 400 at every platform door. Per the ruling's own words, this holds 「for every driver at once」.
- **service-analytics**, re-read by this seat on `origin/main` `1f89ba0d70`. The normalizer's leaf arm carries the comment 「Implicit equality / array → in」 and does `if (Array.isArray(raw)) … leaf('in', …)`. ⇒ the analytics faces read the same object form as membership, `stage IN (won, lost)`, and never route it through the shared face.

Per the implementing round, after #19882 only the analytics `FilterArray` form is refused; the object form still answers.

⇒ one authored filter now gets two answers depending on the surface: a 400 on the data API, and a membership result on an analytics face. That is the divergence the ruling exists to remove, one package over.

## Seam

`spec:assertListComparandShapes` (the shared face) → `service-analytics`' `filter-normalizer` leaf arm. Consumer: the analytics faces.

## Dedupe

None is this defect: #19757 is the ruling's card, and #5442 is a different flattening on driver-memory's analytics face.
